show.description:
Once the heiress of a grand mansion, she is betrayed and reduced to a servant in her own home.
But when a mysterious ally reveals himself as her hidden protector, her lost voice and destiny begin to return. Together, they expose the lies, reunite with a father awakening after sixteen years, and reclaim everything stolen from her. Watch now!
